Solution 05

Pneumatic and Filtration Systems

Fans, blowers, cyclones, air locks and bag filters for air-handled lines.

Request a QuoteContact Our Team

01Overview

What this solution covers.

Pneumatic lines need the right fan, blower, air lock and filter working together. Equipment in this group covers conveying air, dust collection and air breaking, with piping sized to each duty.

Application areas

  • Pneumatic conveying of flour, bran and semolina
  • Dust collection
  • Air supply for cleaning machines

02Process information

How the process runs.

  1. 01

    Air supply

    Fans and blowers provide conveying and cleaning air.

  2. 02

    Separation

    Cyclones separate product from the air stream.

  3. 03

    Filtration

    Bag filters clean dusty air before it is released.

  4. 04

    Air breaking

    Air locks keep air pressure separated at discharge points.
